In HTML, what is a span tag?: A generic inline container for grouping content
In HTML, what is the header element?: A tag used to group introductory content including navigation links
In HTML, what is the main element?: A tag used for the main content of the HTML page
In HTML, what does the bdo element do?: overrides the current direction and renders the text in a new direction
In HTML, what does the datalist element: provides a dropdown list of recommended options
In HTML, what is the small tag?: a tag used to represent small text for side comments or copyright information
In HTML, what is the <tr> tag?: An element that represents a row in a table
In HTML, what is the footer element?: A tag used to specify the footer of the HTML document
In HTML, what does the alt attribute do: It provides a description of the image
